description.value: The Crab Shop is a North Vancouver landmark seafood shop with roots on Dollarton Highway going back to 1961, family-owned by Marcel Gregori since 1993. It specializes in wild, locally-caught BC seafood — including live Dungeness crab harvested on the owner's own fishing vessel — alongside a popular takeaway menu of fish and chips, crab sandwiches, and house-made clam chowder. A seven-time North Shore News Readers' Choice Award winner, it operates out of Dollarton Landing Plaza and draws a loyal following for both its fresh seafood counter and ready-to-eat cooked items.
